art_direction: A bright, funny YouTube thumbnail: a huge crowd of the same man, dozens of Daves packed in rows like a school class photo or a stadium stand, in a warm home-studio room. Each Dave has a different expression (grinning, thinking, shocked, sceptical, smug), some in a light blue-grey shirt, some in a dark navy shirt. In the front, larger and sharper, the real Dave turns to camera with one eyebrow raised and a knowing half-smile, arms crossed, as if to say 'which one is real?'. Keep the TOP-LEFT QUARTER as a plain, slightly darker wall with no faces, for a headline.

video.working_title: I Turned My Headshots Into an AI Picker
video.promise: Demonstrate a system that uses 106 tagged headshots and AI to select an appropriate thumbnail portrait

creative.story: 106 versions of me, and only one is real

presenter.reference_pool: David's favourites (neutrals); expression and pose are set here, not by the photo
